authorization: The user explicitly authorized a full-loop ablation based on the earlier 1,024-update predicted-JEPA experiment.
question: Does proposal-conditioned predicted-JEPA feedback compose with the fixed-Hero1-teacher Hero-v2 recipe, preserving a strong one-pass base while making recurrent DFM inference useful?

prior_result.interpretation: The isolated loop was the only prior architecture arm improved by recurrent inference, but it started from a weaker one-pass policy.

mechanism.first_planner: Produces proposal logits and differentiable action hidden states.
mechanism.proposal_indices: Legal root argmax and deterministic later-horizon argmax; detached and target-safe.
mechanism.jepa: Consumes proposal action IDs plus first-planner action hidden states and recurrently predicts all eight future states.
mechanism.second_planner: Consumes learned projections of predicted JEPA states as per-action context; policy losses apply only to second-planner logits.
mechanism.gradient_path: Final policy gradients flow through the JEPA-to-DFM adapter, JEPA rollout, hidden adapter, and first-planner hidden states; only discrete proposal indices are stopped.

training_design.initialization: Raw BT4 plus seed-0 fresh DFM/JEPA modules; neither arm continues from a candidate checkpoint.

candidate.only_intended_delta: Enable the full loop and instantiate its isolated-name initialized JEPA-rollout-to-DFM adapter.

systems_gate.diagnostic_profile: 10 updates on L40S before either 1,024-update launch
requirements: All losses and gradients are finite with zero skipped or nonfinite updates.
The immutable Hero1 teacher loads with exact state identity and zero trainable parameters.
dfm_closed_loop_active equals 1 and closed-loop context RMS is finite and positive.
At least 1 GiB of physical HBM headroom remains at peak reservation.
Median useful throughput over updates 3 through 10 is at least 150 examples per second.
No recovery or model checkpoint is written by the diagnostic.

training_comparisons: Examples-weighted total and component-loss curves on the common data prefix.
Frozen DFM CE, legal-masked root CE/top-1, WDL loss/accuracy/calibration, JEPA positive loss, SIGReg, target/prediction RMS, and effective/stable rank.
Candidate second-planner versus detached first-planner DFM CE improvement.
Exact parameter movement and adapter activity.
analysis.representation_policy: JEPA noninferiority to the 554-update control is diagnostic, not a short-run veto. Hard failures are nonfinite values, collapse against trivial baselines, pathological RMS ratio outside [0.5, 2.0], or material rank collapse.

arena_plan.selection: deterministic greedy legal argmax with color reversal
comparisons: candidate one pass versus control one pass
candidate eight passes versus candidate one pass
candidate eight passes versus control one pass
candidate eight passes versus control eight passes
arena_plan.requirements: Implement and test a content-bound opening offset before launch; do not silently reuse inspected pairs 0 through 255.

mechanism_success: Candidate eight-pass point score exceeds 0.5 versus its own one-pass policy.
Candidate eight-pass point score is at least 0.5 versus control one-pass, or its pair-aware interval excludes a material deficit below 0.45.
Candidate one-pass pair-aware interval versus control does not support a material deficit below 0.45.
Offline latent-health and systems gates pass with zero arena faults and complete move-codec coverage.
decision_rule.retain_for_longer_scaling: Mechanism success authorizes a newly bounded longer comparison; it does not itself promote a terminal Hero2.
decision_rule.reject: Reject this composition if recurrent inference is not useful, if the one-pass base is materially damaged without eight-pass recovery, or if numerical/latent collapse occurs.
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_tuning: Do not change distillation, learning rate, loop adapter scale, pass count, or loss coefficients after inspecting this run.

budget.rule: Refresh Modal billing immediately before every launch and stop if the repository guard rejects it.
